༄༅/ /dag yig tshig gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dag yig tshig gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañju gho ṣā ya/ /rgyal kun kun mkhyen phung bo gcig bsdus nas/ /ma lus lus can 'gro la blo gros mchog /ster mdzad mdzad pa phul byung lhag pa'i lha/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha mos dge legs stsol/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i rnam 'phrul mi yi gar/ /bod yul yi ge'i srol 'byed thu mi zhes/ /gangs khrod mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sam+bho ṭa'i/ /bka' drin lan brgyar dran pas rtag tu bsngags/ /gang thugs zab gsal dag pa'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i gru char babs pa'i rgyun/ /bdag blo'i za ma tog tu legs 'khyil ba/ /don gnyer 'ga' la phan 'dod yid kyis sbyin/ /de yang thu mi lo tsā bas/ /rgya gar yi ge lnga bcu ni/ /bod yig sum cur gtan phab pa/ /ka sogs gsal byed sum cu ste/ /dbyangs yig i u e o bzhi/ /gi gu zhabs kyu 'greng bu dang*/ /na ro bzhir 'gyur logs su med/ /ming gzhi'i yi ge sum cu las/ /ka ca ta pa tsa rnams pho/ kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning/ /ga ja da ba dza wa dang*/ /zha za 'a ya sha sa mo/ /nga nya na ma shin tu mo/ /ra la ha rnams mo gsham mo/ /'di las ga da ba ma 'a/ /sngon 'jug lnga'o nang gses kyis/ /ba pho ga da gnyis ma ning*/ /'a mo ma ni shin tu mo/ /ming gis gang gi sngon 'jug pa/ /ba ni ka ga ca ta da/ /tsa zha za sha sa bcur 'jug /ga ni ca nya ta da na/ /tsa zha za ya sha sa ste/ /bcu gcig la 'jug das 'phul ni/ /ka ga nga pa ba ma drug /'a ni kha ga cha ja tha/ /da pa ba tsha dza bcur 'jug /ma ni kha ga nga cha ja/ /nya tha da na tsha dza ste/ /bcu gcig la'o brtsegs 'phul ni/ /ba las gzhan du yod ma yin/ / rjes 'jug ga nga da na pa/ /ma 'a ra la sa bcu las/ /nang gses da ba sa gsum pho/ /'a ra gnyis mo ga nga na/ /ma la lnga pho ma ning ngo*/ /rjes 'jug pho mo ma ning gsum/ /drag zhan bar ma'i tshul gyis 'jug /tshig bar gcig tu pho gsum nyid/ /nang phrad drag po'o de la yang*/ /rab 'bring tha gsum la sogs pa/

/ lhag ma gzhan yang shes par bya/ /mgo can ra la sa gsum ni/ /ra la btags pa bcu gsum ste/ /rka rga rnga rja rnya rta rda/ /rna rba rma rtsa rdza rla'o/ /lar btags lka lga lnga lca lja/ lta lda lpa lba lha ste bcu/ /sa mgo can ni bcu gnyis te/ ska sga snga snya sta sda sna/ /spa sba sma stsa sla rnams so/ /ra ya la wa'i 'dogs bzhi ni/ ra btags bcu ste kra khra gra/ /tra dra pra phra bra mra sra'o/ /ya btags bdun te kya khya gya/ /pya phya bya mya rnams su 'dod/ /la btags yi ge kla gla bla/ /zla rla sla ste drug yin no/ /wa btags kwa khwa gwa cwa dang*/ /rtswa tshwa zhwa dang zwa rwa shwa/ /swa hwa rnam pa bcu gnyis so/ /dag yig tshig gsal sgron me las yi ge'i dbye ba spyir bstan pa ste dang po'o// //de nas ka la sogs pa kun/ /rim bzhin rkyang 'phul mgo can dang*/ /dbyangs bzhi 'dogs ldan rjes 'jug gis/ /brgyan te rgyas par bshad par bya/ /ka la siṅka ke la sha /kun mkhyen ku sha ka shi ka /klu rgyal chu klung ka ma la/ /klong yangs ka dag ku mu da/ /ka ra wī ra ke ta ka /ka ba ka ra ka pā la/ / keng rus 'di ko ke ke ru/ /ko ba lungs kar ka ca'i dngos/ /ku shu gur kum lcags kyus btab/ /kye ma kye hud kye kye 'bod/ /krog krog krong krong mgo kyog kyog /kog gi ker langs ku re byas/ /ku co kyal ka klan ka'i rgyu/ /nyen kor ke'u kun dong za/ /do ker stod kor klad kor byin/ /kar kar zug langs bad kan nad/ /ku ya kla klo skyil krung bcas/ /kwa ye 'byams klas klog kyang klogs/ /dpyid ka ku hu kyur kyur skad/ /mang tshig kun sogs ka rkyang ngo*/ / mdog dkar dkar chags chu ma dkrugs/ /dkor mdzod dkyil 'khor dbus dkyil du/ /dkrong bskyed dkon cog dka' thub dkon/ /dkyus ring dkyus ma kun dkris che/ /sprin dkrigs zho dkrogs rol mo dkrol/ /dkar yol dka' 'grel dkrigs phrag gcig /lus kyi dgu la gos kyis dkris/

/dkan gzar la sogs das 'phul ka'o/ /bkra shis bkrag mdangs kha dog bkra/ /bka' lung khal bkal skud pa bkal/ /pho nya 'od bkye me tog bkram/ /bcings bkrol dri ma bkru bkrus bkren/ /bkres skom logs bkar srog bkum bkag /snod bkar bsnyen bkur bkur stis mchod/ /bkod legs bder bkod zur du bkol/ /shing bkug snod bkas g.yog tu bkol/ /gzhu bkang gos bkab thag pas bkyigs/ /bka' drin bka' bkyon rtsa ba bkog / yar bkan spa bkod rim gyis bkri/ /mdo bklags zin sogs bas 'phul ka'o/ /rkang lag rkan phug 'doms kyi rkub/ /chom rkun rgyu rkyen phye rkyal rku/ /sa rko gan rkyal rked pa rkyong*/ /rka mgor rkyal rtse ri dwags rkyang*/ /chig rkyang la sogs rar btags ka'o/ /lkog gyur lkog ma lkog shal dang*/ /dge lkugs byas sogs lar btags ka'o/ /ska cog rnam gnyis skar ma skag /lus skem snum skud skud pa sgril/ /skyo ma ska rags skyu ru ra/ /skyes bu zhal skyems skyur bu skol/ /bya skon myur skyen skyo bsangs byed/ /skem byed skul byed skor ba byed/ /chang skyugs kha skyengs skran gyi nad/ /skya sbab skrangs shing ri skegs skad/ /chu skyar skya ga skrag nas bros/ /dge skos bya skrog skyo ngogs byas/ /skud po'i ske la og skor skyes/ /rgya skyegs skyed tshal shing skyer ba/ /them skas skyon skyob skyabs 'gro skyor/ /chos skyong sa skyong re skong skyid/ /bya skrod srab skyogs skyos ma skyel/ /ji skad 'di skad kha skong skabs/ /dbu skra skad cig skar khung gsal/ /sbas skungs mtha' skor skal ba ldan/ /sgul skyod skye mched thugs dam skong*/ /mtha' skyor skya rengs sar btags ka'o/ /'dod la brkam pas brku bya brkus/ /sra brkyang lag brkyang brko bya brkos/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ka'o/ /byug pa bsku bskus lag pa bskums/ /'phrin bskur dbang bskur chos la bskul/

/nor bskyi bskyis byin bskyin pa bskyal/ /gos bskon rtar bskyon slar yang bskyar/ /bgegs bskrad bcom bskyungs sa bon bskrun/ /bskal mes chu bskams bskal don dang*/ /'pho bskyas rgyang bskyur bya ba bskyungs/ /mi bskyod bskor nas rgyal sar bskos/ /ro bska kha bskangs thugs dam bskangs/ /sems bskyed rgya bskyed brjed pa'i bskyud/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ka'o/ kho bo go khrab khri khrag mang*/ khrag khrig khrus byas khro ba dang*/ khong khro khon 'dzin khro bo khros/ khong khrag khrung khrung khwa ta'i khyu/ /tshul khrims khru gang khri yi khrod/ khram kha btab cing khang khyim khyams/ /bya khra khyis khyer khre khyor gang*/ kho ra khor yug khron pa'i kha/ kha dog khro gnyer sil snyan khrol/ khams gsum dur khrod sna khrid byas/ khrums stod khrel yod kha rkyang ngo*/ /mkhas pas mkhyen cing mkhan po mkho/ /sra mkhrang mkhregs shing dpe mkhyud byed/ /zhu mkhan mkhur tshos mkhal ma dang*/ /nam mkha' mkhrig ma sa yi mkhar/ /mkhris pa la sogs mas 'phul kha'o/ /'khor lo 'khor bcas 'khod nas bskor/ /blo 'khums zhe 'khon ma mgu 'khang*/ /'khyags nas mtha' 'khob 'khyar zhing 'khyams/ /rgas 'khogs rkang 'khum 'khyor bas 'khyog /'khar ba la 'khril mgul nas 'khyud/ /'khrig tshig ngag 'khyal 'thab 'khrugs langs/ /nor 'khrul sku 'khrungs bro gar 'khrab/ /sems 'khrugs khur 'khur 'khar rnga 'khrol/ /'od 'khyil ma 'khyog srad bu 'khol/ /bskur ba 'khyol sogs 'as 'phul kha'o/ / grub mtha' grub thob grangs med grags/ /'ching grol ral gri gro gas gril/ / grang nad grum bus grongs pa med/ /skar ma mon gru gre gro bzhin/ /chos grwa'i gral du rim gro byas/ /yul gru gru bzhi chu yi gru/ /grabs byed grong khyer 'bru nas gro/ /gro ma grod pa grum zhing grim/ /gra bar gros gleng grib ma bsil/ /grogs byas glud btang glang ltar glen/

/gla rtsi gla rngan gling bu'i glu/ /'dzam gling glegs bam nang khrol glo/ /glang chen glags rnyed glos phab nyal/ /bya glag glog 'khyug lhan pa glan/ /dngos grub gzhi grub tha gru yangs/ /lhun grub la sogs ga rkyang ngo*/ /dge ba dge 'dun dge sbyong dgu/ /dge bsnyen dge tshul dga' nas dgod/ /dgung sngon dge bshes yi ger dgod/ /dgra bcom dgongs dgrol thugs dges dgyes/ /dgag sgrub logs dgar dgon par gnas/ /snod dgang kha dgab me tog dgram/ /dgun ka dgongs mo ri dgas dgo / dgug gzhug dgung lo das 'phul ga'o/ /bka' bgro bgro gleng bgyid phyir bgrod/ /go bgos bgegs bskrad tshod pags bgyis/ /bgrang yas los bgres spyan bgrad lta/ /bgo snyal nor bgos gad mo bgad/ /rnyog ma bgrungs sogs bas 'phul ga'o/ /mgo mgul mgrin pas mgur dbyangs byas/ / mgron po mgar ba mgu nas byon/ /mgon po mgal me myur ba'i mgyogs/ / ya mgal ma mgal mas 'phul ga'o/ /'gro ba lam 'gro 'grim zhing 'grul/ / logs 'gying 'gros 'gor 'gran zla 'grib/ /'go ba lto 'grangs gzhu 'gengs 'gyangs/ /chu 'gog 'gags nas 'ga' zhig 'greng*/ /mnyam 'grogs tshig 'grel srog 'gum 'gyel/ /'gul nas chos dang 'gal bas 'gyod/ /dben pa'i 'gol sar 'go nad 'gos/ /bder 'god 'gong po 'phel 'grib byed/ /lam gyi 'gron 'gugs mkhar gyi 'gram/ /brtson 'grus don 'grub thog ma'i 'go /rigs 'gre klad 'gems 'thab mo 'gyed/ /chu 'grems la sogs 'as 'phul ga'o/ /rgyal ba rgyal bo rgya mtshor rgyu/ /bya rgod rgan po rga shis rgud/ /gtam rgyud phreng rgyud rgyud mang sgra/ /dbu rgyan phas rgol rgyang ring rgyug /rgod ma sha rgyas lus kyi rgyab/ /dmu rgod bying rgod khyi rgya bo/ /rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa rgyu mtshan can/ /rgyu 'bras nga rgyal dregs pa'i rgyags/ /rgya 'gram rgyob cig rgyal mtshan 'dzin/

/nya rgyas rgyus pa rgyu ma bzung*/ /rgya gar rgya che rar btags ga'o/ /la lga lgang ba nyid du nges/ /'ga' zhig sman gyi lga la'ang bzhed/ /sgom chen sgor mo mkhar ba'i sgo/ /blo sgam lcags sgrog sgril ba'i sgra/ /zhum pa'i sgyid lug sgyed bu skyel/ /sgyu rtsal g.yo sgyu sgyu ma mkhan/ /sgrung shod shing sgrom sgro ba sgye/ /sgyug mo sgo nga sgog pa zos/ /sdig sgrib las sgrel chos sgra sgrogs/ /sgal tshigs sgren mo 'gyis nas sgug /sgyid khung sgro gu'i mdud pas sgrog /gyen sgreng sgar btab rta yi sga/ /bshad sgrub sgrol ma klu sgrub sgrubs/ / mna' sgog sgyogs 'phen sgyur bar byed/ /sgang gshong sgron me sgos su sgron/ / sgrub byed la sogs sar btags ga'o/ /chu brgal brgal brtag brgya phrag brgyad/ /rgyan gyis brgyan cing gad brgyangs che/ /phreng brgyus 'o brgyal dran med brgyal/ /brgyud pa rim brgyud brgyud mar byon/ /brgyab zin la sogs bas 'phul ba'i/ /ra mgo ldan pa'i ga nyid do/ /chos dang mdog bsgyur bka' bsgo bsgos/ /chur bsgral chos bsgrags don bsgoms zin/ /rigs bsgres blo bsgrims rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /mna' bsgags lam bsgugs bag chags bsgos/ /sgra bsgrags 'od bsgribs phyogs gcig bsgrigs/ /bsgrun par mi nus bsgrub bya bsgrubs/ /mi bskul bya ba'i bsgang la sogs/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ga'o/ /snyan dngags zil dngar tshar dud ngar/ /gser dngul dngos po dngos med chos/ /dngos grub dngos gzhi dngos dngos gnas/ /skrag dngangs la sogs das 'phul nga'o/ /mnga' ris mnga' zhabs mnga' thang che/ / mnga' mdzad mnga' bdag mngag gzhug mngags/ /mngon sum mngon gyur skye gnas mngal/ /mnga' brnyes mngon shes thugs la mnga'/ /mngon spyod chos mngon mngar ba'i ro/ /gnod pa'i mngan sogs mas 'phul nga'o/ /rnga brdung rnga yab rngom brjid can/ /rngon pa rngam nas rnga mo 'ded/

/dbugs rngub zug rngu nad kyi rngo/ /lus rngul gla rngan mthug pa'i rngam/ /rnga rngog nas rngo rtswa sogs rnga/ /rus kyi rngog sogs rar btags nga'o/ /zhal snga spyan snga snga ma sngon/ /sngags pa mdog sngo gsang sngags so/ /mdun gyi sngun du sngo bar byed/ /mtshang nas sngogs sogs sar btags nga'o/ /rtswa sogs brngas pa rar btags nga'o/ /bstod bsngags dge rtsa bsngo bya bsngos/ /sdug bsngal rnam par bsngos pa sogs/ /'as 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nga'o/ /ci ltar ci slad ci yi phyir/ khyed cag nged cag mig can sogs/ /sum cu drug cu bdun cu dang*/ /brgyad cu sems can yin no cog /lhan cig skad cig kha cig zer/ /shog cig gyur cig sdod cig ces/ /ci ste ha cang ca co byed/ /ci nas cang shes cig shos dgos/ /co to thor cog cod pan 'chang/ /be con cig car cam gyis 'jog /co 'dri mur cor smras lta ci/ / na cig cis kyang mig ce re/ /cong dang cang te'u ci zhig brdungs/ /cang mi shes pa'i brag cas ci/ /cog tse cu gang ca rkyang ngo*/ /gcad bya shing gcod zhal lce gcod/ /grogs kyi yid bcugs gcen dang gcung*/ /lag pa gcus shing gcin gci ba/ /tshar gcod gces pa yid la gcags/ /sgra gcan gcan gzan gcong rong lhung*/ /gcig bu ro gcig rdzas gcig 'dod/ /rdo gcog gcer bu gcam bu'i tshig /gcal du bkram sogs gas 'phul ca'o/ /bcom ldan dgra bcom zhabs kyis bcags/ /dam bcas khrims bca' lag pas bcangs/ /shing bcad tshigs bcad bca' gzhir bcings/ /bstan bcos logs bcar bza' bca'i bcud/ /mig bcar phyir bcil nang du bcug /chu bcus las bcol rta la bcibs/ /tshar bcad nor bcang zhal bce bcad/ / bcas rang sbas bcabs chung ngur bcums/ /bca' lga bcos legs bas 'phul ca'o/ /lcug phran mnyen lcug mgo lcog ldems/ /lcang ma'i lcags dbyug blo yis lcogs/ /lcags gong lci zhing me lce 'bar/ /lcang lo can gyi lcags ri'i lcog

/sbal lcong lcung ka g.yang khar lceb/ /smra ba'i lce sogs lar btags ca'o/ /cha lang chem chem chu yi char/ /chags bral chen po chag shes che/ /byang chub ched du rin chen chos/ /go cha cha lugs chabs gcig tu/ /chibs pa chibs la chad pas chod/ /sa phyogs chag chag 'bras chan chang*/ /srog chags mthar chags chab 'og chug /cha rkyen thag chod cha shas cha/ /thugs chud chung ma cho rigs bzang*/ /chab shog kha chem cham pa'i nad/ /bag chags cho 'phrul chal chil g.yo/ /cho nge 'don sogs cha rkyang ngo*/ /dkon mchog mchod pa mchog tu dges/ /skyabs mchi grogs mched yi ge'i mchan/ /mchis 'brang mchil ma mchi ma phyung*/ kha mchu bka' mchid ma mchis so/ /skye mched me mched rgya mtsho'i mching*/ /rin chen mching bu gzhu'i mchog ma/ kha yi mchu sogs mas 'phul cha'o/ /chos 'chang khrams 'cha' gar 'chams byed/ /tshul 'chos srog 'chad 'dod la 'chums/ /'char sgo mi 'chugs sbed pa'i 'chab/ khas 'chi 'ching zhags 'chang zhing 'chus/ /nyi ma 'char sogs 'as 'phul cha'o/ /ji lta ji snyed ji bzhin mkhyen/ /ji ltar ji srid ji skad zer/ /jo bo jo mo ja je bzang*/ /jag pa la sogs ja rkyang ngo*/ /rten mjal mjug ma mjings pa mkhrang*/ /rtags kyi mje sogs mas 'phul ja'o/ /'jam mnyen snyan 'jebs mnyam par 'jog /'jig rten 'jim rdzab mi rtag 'jig /skrag 'jigs 'jus nas khrag sogs 'jib/ /rjes 'jug khrims 'jag 'dod pa 'jo/ /zas 'ju 'jo sgeg gos 'jol 'jol/ /'jag mar 'jabs nas nor sogs mjal/ /skyon 'jil 'ja' tshon ser sna'i 'jungs/ /'ja' brdeg tshur 'jug 'jor bus brkos/ /'jud 'thun la sogs 'as 'phul ja'o/ /rje btsun rdo rje thugs rjes bzung*/ /rje dpon rjes 'jug rkang rjes bzhag /rjod byed sha rjen rje ngar rjud/ /snying rje rje'u sogs rang btags ja'o/ /brjod bya brjod cing phan tshun brje/ /brjid che brjed byed mi dran brjed/

/bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ja'o/ /yul ljongs sman ljongs ljan ljin khrod/ /ljon shing ljang bu ljid lci ba/ / ljang khu ljags sogs lar btags ja'o/ /nyams rtogs nyams len nyag gcig pu/ /nying khu nyis 'gyur nyung ngu nyos/ /nyon mongs nying shas nyan thos nyams/ /nyin par nyam chung nyam thag nyal/ /pho nya nyams dgar 'byung nyen che/ /nying dgos sbos nyug zla ba nya/ /nya sha nya mang nyan cing nyon/ /nye bar nye reg nyag phran 'phen/ /nyal nyil la sogs nya rkyang ngo*/ /dpung gnyen bshes gnyen nye du'i gnyen/ /gnya' ltag gnya' shing don gnyer che/ /klu gnyan bka' gnyan khro gnyer bsdus/ /gnyer ba gnyid log gnyug mar gnas/ /mi mthun gnyen po gas 'phul nya'o/ /thugs mnyes 'jam mnyen rna bas mnyan/ /mnyed mnyes cha mnyam mnyam par bzhag /gru yi mnyan pa mas 'phul nya'o/ /rnyed bkur rnyog ma gsar rnying rnyed/ /sa rnyil rnyid pa rar btags nya'o/ /don snying snying rje 'bru'i snye ma/ /go snyod snying bo chang sogs snyol/ /tha snyad ji snyed de snyed snyam/ /snyun med snyom las nor gyis snyems/ /snyoms 'jug btang snyoms reg bya snyi/ /bsod snyoms snyugs ring snyeg sar snyogs/ /snyad 'dogs tshig snyan snyim pa gang*/ /snyigs dus la sogs sar btags nya'o/ /gzugs brnyan sgra brnyan sku brnyan byed/ /mnga' brnyes brnyas smod phyag brnyan sogs/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i nya'o/ /dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas bsnyen par rdzogs/ / bsnyen sgrub bsnyen bkur phye mar bsnyil/ /gtam bsnyad phyir bsnyil mal du bsnyal/ /lag bsnyabs bsnyung gzhis bsnyun pa bde/ /zas bsnyod rjes bsnyegs 'jigs pa'i bsnyengs/ khas mi len pa'i bsnyon pa sogs/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i nya'o/ /gcu gtor thor to dbyug to dang*/ mu tig me tog za ma tog /tog co rtsi tog rin chen tog /lo tog dza ti ting nge 'dzin/ / yon tan nan tan ting lo sbar/ /gal te kha ton zhal ta ba/ /shang shang te'u ting shag ting*/

/tang tang tong tong tog tog sgra/ /ling tog la sogs ta rkyang ngo*/ / bsam gtan gtan tshigs gtan gyi bde/ /gtun shing gtum po'i lag tu gtang*/ /brdung gtag gtor ma gtang rag gtong*/ /gter gyis nang gtams gzhan la gtong*/ /chu gtor 'bem gtod dmigs par gtod/ /sbyin gtong zhabs gtugs zad pa'i gtugs/ /gti mug mtshang gtol se gol gtogs/ khrag gtar gting ring mun pa gtibs/ /sgo gtan gtur bu ri yi gtos/ / sbos gtul mgo gtums khongs su gtogs/ /gtam gleng gtan 'bebs gas 'phul ta'o/ /ming btags sgro btags kha btags btags/ /spyir btang blos btang me tog btu/ /srol gtod gdan bting sa bon btab/ /zhabs btud gsol btab gyen du bteg /bza' btung rgyas btab byed rung btub/ /spu btog phyer btags rtsa nas bton/ /dgra bo btul sogs bas 'phul ta'o/ / rtag dang mi rtag mtshon pa'i rtags/ /mi rtog rtog pa dbang rtul rta/ /lung rtogs don rtogs yid rton pa/ /rmongs rtul phyi rting rtod pas bcings/ /rtul phod rta babs bya ma rta/ /rten 'brel rtog ge mi gtsang rtug /ru rta la sogs rar btags ta'o/ /ltos 'gro'i lto ba de lta bu/ /lto 'phye'i ltag par ltad mo lta/ / ltogs pas lto zos ltem gyis gang*/ /lta ngan lta ba log par ltung*/ /ltung ba da lta yod med ltos/ /re ltos lta ci mda' yi ltong*/ /ltar ltar po sogs lar btags ta'o/ /ston pa'i bzhugs stangs bkur sti stobs/ /stabs legs mu stegs byad stems shi/ /lta stangs me stag cang mi sto/ /sta gon stong grogs sha stag byed/ /stag g.yag stobs ldan sta zur ston/ /gzhogs stegs rkang stabs nags stug po/ /dgra sta sta re ste'u rno/ /ston dus star kha'i ston mo ster/ /nor stor stan bting mngal sgo stu/ /ro stod stong nyid sar btags ta'o/ /brtag bya brtag dpyad kun brtags brtags/ /gnas brtan yid brtan brtul zhugs brtan/

/sbubs brtol mjug brtul brtson pa'i brtun/ /gzhi la brten nas thag pas brtod/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /sku bltams blta bya legs par bltas/ /bltos sa bltos chos gos bltab sogs/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /thub bstan chos bstan bla ma bsten/ /pa sti stang 'phro bstud kyi ngor bstan/ /bstan bcos dang bstun de la bstim/ /bsti gnas bsting chog grogs kyi bstang*/ /byin len bstabs zin bstod pas bstod/ / bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /thun mong thu bo tha gru che/ /thu mi thor cog thor tshugs dang*/ /ngan pa'i tha ma tha ma kha/ /tha chad thab sogs tha rkyang ngo*/ /mtho ris mtha' dag mtha' yas mthong*/ /nus mthu mthar phyin mthun mi mthun/ /lag mthil mthe bong mthe'u chung*/ /mthon ka mthon mthing mthang gos mthug /mthar gyis rta mthur mtho yor mtho/ /mtho 'tshams mthol bshags rgya mthongs mtha'/ /mthon po mthing ril mas 'phul tha'o/ /'thab mor 'thon yang grogs su 'thams/ /sprin 'thib chu 'thor du ba 'thul/ /blo 'thums mgo 'thoms sra zhing 'thas/ /chu 'thung sha 'thog skra nas 'then/ /phyer 'thag 'bru 'thu dum bu 'thub/ /'thum bu 'thad sogs 'as 'phul tha'o/ /ya rabs dra ma bka' drin can/ /gos dra drub dang dri ba dris/ /dra ba dra phyed dril bu dri/ /dred po khrims dral drung bor grags/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog drang srong drang*/ /snga dro drang don g.yu drung drug /zas drangs drongs shig sa la drud/ /dom dred drod che zan dron dril/ /nad drag drung 'byin nor gyis dregs/ /drag po la sogs da rkyang ngo*/ /gdugs dkar gdong ba gdugs kyis gdungs/ /gdul bya gdol ba gdug pa can/ /gdams ngag gsal gdab gding ba gdan/ /gdung rus skad gdangs skas kyi gdangs/ /gdung brgyud gsol gdab sa bon gdab/ /bcol gdams ming gdags gdon dang bral/ kha gdangs mtshon gdengs gdon mi za/ /da gdod sos gdal gdeng thob gda'/

/thud gdar gdengs can dam la gdags/ /dang po'i gdod ma gdags pa'i gzhi/ /srang la gdeg sogs gas 'phul da'o/ /bde gshegs bde legs bden pa bdar/ /bdag gzhan bdud bcom bdug spos bdug /mdun bdar lnga bdo ro bda' ba/ /gzhu bdungs bdud rtsi phye mar bdar/ /bdog pa'i dngos po ri dwags bda'/ /phyag bdar la sogs bas 'phul da'o/ /lam mdor mdos 'phen mda' mdung mde'u/ /sgro mdongs mdog mdangs mdor bsdus mdo/ /mdun du mdangs sang mdud pa mdud/ /ra mda' la sogs mas 'phul da'o/ /mya ngan 'da' 'das 'dun pas 'dud/ /'dam khrod 'dur 'dur 'dong zhing 'dug /nang 'dom 'dom gang smad kyi 'doms/ /rjes 'ded gsol 'debs 'don pa 'don/ /lha 'dre shing 'dru khung bu 'dru/ /'du byed 'dus byas 'dres ma 'dra/ /chos 'doms gtam 'dri yi ge 'dri/ /'dod chags 'dris pas srog 'dor 'dar/ /'dul ba 'dren pas dge 'dun 'dul/ /ri 'dab pad 'dab 'dab chags 'du/ khrims 'dral 'do med 'du shes chung*/ /ming 'dogs 'dod sogs 'as 'phul da'o/ /grong rdal thog rdib sa rdo'i rdul/ /rde'u rdog po thabs rdugs rdegs/ /rdo rje pheb rdob cha lang rdob/ /lag rdum glo rdol dbu ba rdos/ /gri rdor la sogs rar btags da'o/ /'phur lding 'brug ldir skad ldab ldib/ /lda ldi lde mig lto ldir ldan/ / seng ldeng ldem ldem ldeng bzo'i ldebs/ /ldong ros ngad ldang lde gu byug /phyir ldog mi ldog btung ba ldud/ /me lce ldum rar ldum bu skyes/ /bcom ldan ldem dgongs drin lan ldon/ /bskyar ldab ldob skyen lar btags da'o/ /sde ba sde tshan sdong bo sdom/ /zhe sdang sdang mig sdigs mdzub can/ /sdig sdug phyogs sdeb sdom pas sdoms/ /mdzes sdug mchod sdong do sdau ba/ /sder ma bka' sdod sder mo rno/ /sde snod la sogs sar btags da'o/ /grib rdar brdeg bya brdung bya brdung*/

kha brdar brda byas bla brdol smra/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i da'o/ /bldabs nas bldag cing mur ba'i bldad/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i nga'o/ /bsdu bya bsdu bsdus phan tshun bsdur/ /srog bsdos nyer bsdogs phyogs gcig bsdoms/ /nyes pa bsdams byas gzhan la bsdigs/ /sna thag bsdogs sogs stan la bsdad/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i da'o/ /'dug gnas gnod byed zil gyis gnon/ /gnad don gnod sbyin sngon gyi gna'/ /gnas brtan gnyer gnas gnas skabs bde/ /gnas lugs zhe gnong gnas ngan len/ /gnam dang gnag sogs gas 'phul na'o/ /lung mnos mnal gzims bsam mno gtong*/ /mna' ma dri mnam mnar med mnar/ /mna' bskyal mnar sems mas 'phul na'o/ /rnam mkhyen rnam shes rnal 'byor rno/ /rnam rtog rnam grangs rnam pa mang*/ /rna ba rnag khrag rnam dbye rnams/ /rnal ma la sogs rar btags na'o/ /sna lce bar snang snron dang snubs/ /snar ma snag tsha sna tshogs snur/ /snam sbyar snam bu sna yi snabs/ /snang gsal snum dri snom zhing snang*/ /ser sna snrel zhi mang du snon/ /ltar snang la sogs sar btags na'o/ /brnab sems nges bzung nan tan brnan/ /bsam pa'i brnag dang bzod dka'i brnag /zas kyis brnangs dang 'then pa'i brnar/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i na'o/ /nu ma mda' bsnun mang du bsnan/ /srol bsnubs mtshon bsnams gong 'og bsnor/ /dus bsnur mjug bsnar zhib mor bsnur/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan pa'i na'o/ /rang gi pang par pi wang 'dzin/ /gcig pur pir gyis pa tra bris/ / mkhar gyi pu shu bya bu shud/ /pus btsugs pog por ga pur 'thul/ /par btab po ti po ta la/ /prog zhu 'og bag pi pi ling*/ /pa sangs sems pa bsam pa bzang*/ /bar gyis 'phar sogs pa rkyang ngo*/ /dpa' bo dpag tshad rjes su dpag /byang chub sems dpa' dpag bya dpog /dpya khral dar dpyangs dpang bo dpe/ /dpung ba dpangs mtho dmag dpung dpon/

/dpag med dpal ldan rnam dpyod dpyad/ /slob dpon dpyid ka dpyas mi 'dogs/ /dpral ba dpye mgo das 'phul ba'o/ /mdzes pa'i spa ba spang spos spu/ /spun zla spang bya spangs pas spro/ /sprin spros longs spyod spyad pa spyod/ /spen ma spyi bo rgyan gyis spud/ /gos sprug nor spel spra tshil springs/ /gnas spar me spor g.yul sprad sprod/ /'phar sbyang spre'u sbrul pa'i spyan/ /gos spo tshig gis spyos nas sbyugs/ /tshur sbyon spyang bo spobs pa che/ khe sbog rgyan spras 'byar byed sbyin/ / dga' spror gdung spung ri yi spo/ /thags kyi spun sogs sar btags pa'o/ / stag lpags la sogs lar btags pa'o/ /pha ma mi pham phyin chad phrad/ /brug gu phan tshun rdul phran phra/ /bcu phrag phyogs su phyug po phyin/ /phyags mas phyi sa'i phye ma phyags/ /nas phye phying ba phyag dar phyor/ /phyi dro nam phyed phyen gtong phyung*/ /phongs nas phrag dog phra ma byas/ /phyugs kyi phru ma phye ma le ba/ /sgo phye phran tshegs phreng ba phrogs/ /phyag gi phrag pa smin phrag par/ /tshig phrad la sogs pha rkyang ngo*/ /gzhan la 'phya 'phyas 'od 'phro 'phros/ /'phyi bar mda' 'phen 'phangs tshe 'phog /go 'phang dung 'phyur 'phral du 'phangs/ /dar 'phyar 'phyang dang phyag dar 'phyag /lto 'phye 'phye bo 'phang skyen grag /'phongs kyis 'phag 'phag mgo 'phur 'phur/ /sems la 'phreng sogs 'as 'phul ba'o/ / bla ma bla gos bla bre bres/ /byams pa byang chub bla na med/ /bye mas byad byur byabs pas brel/ /bran g.yog byes byon byug pa byin/ /byis pas bya ra'i bya ba byos/ /bya byi'u byi ba byi la'i brun/ /byol song brang 'gro'i brang byil byil/ /blag pa blun pos blus kyang bla/ /byad bzhin 'dam bying blo blong blong*/ /bro nad dang bral bros shing byer/ /byi bo bro brdung yi ge bris/ /sos blad chu blus zas sogs brims/

/yo byad bre gang byur bur blugs/ /bla tshe byang bu bla thabs su/ /bla gdags skra byi cha byad blangs/ /bye brag rgyal blon rna ba blags/ /ro bro bra ba phyi ru byas/ /byang phyogs byung sogs ba rkyang ngo*/ /dbu skra dbu ma dbu ba dbus/ /rnam dbye dbye nas kha yi dbugs/ /chos dbyings dbyibs legs dbyer mi phyed/ / dbyu gu dbyig pa dbyug pa dbyugs/ /dbang phyug dbang bskur dbang ldan phyogs/ /dbul bo phyir dbyung dben pa'i gnas/ /dbon pos dbyangs byas gtan la dbab/ /dbang thang byin dbab dbyar gyi dus/ /dbyig gi gnyen sogs das 'phul ba'o/ /'bras 'bru rab 'byams 'ba' zhig 'byor/ /'byung ba 'brel chags 'bras bu 'byung*/ /'bring bo 'brog pa 'bri 'brong g.yag / 'bel gtam sgo 'byed 'brom ston 'byon/ /phyir 'brang 'byung bo 'bros shing 'byer/ /'brub khung kha 'byed 'brum nad 'byin/ /mtshang 'bru chang 'byo sbyar nas 'byar/ /skra 'bal la sogs 'as 'phul ba'o/ /khyi rbad rbad sgril kha rbad che/ /thags rbad bcad sogs rar btags pa'o/ /lbu ba lba ba lar btags pa'o/ /sbyin bdag nor sbyin gnod sbyin dbang*/ /sbun pa sbang ma rta sogs spangs/ /sbub tu sbos sbas sba zhing sbed/ /nyis sbrags sbra 'bubs sbrel nas sbyar/ /sbur mar me sbar sbal pa sbos/ /sbrum ma lto sbo grog sbur sbrul/ /skad sbron lus sbrid sa le sbram/ /dge sbyong sdig sbyangs gtsang sbra sbyor/ /chur spangs sbud lcags 'dom gyi sba/ /sba mkhar la sogs sar btags pa'o// //nyams myong ro myang mya ngan 'da'/ /myu gu ro myags chang gis myos/ /myur du nags myul ma rkyang ngo*/ /dmigs bsal nyes dmigs dmyal bar ltung*/ /dmu chu nyams dmas dmangs rigs dman/ /dmus long dmigs su dmigs pa med/ /bu ga'i dmig pu dmu rgod dmag /dme bo mdog dmar dmod pa byas/ /'dzum dmul dma' ba das 'phul ma'o/

/ngo mtshar rmad byung rmi lam rmis/ /zhing rmo rmongs rmugs khyis rmur rmugs/ /rma byung rta rmig sga yi rmad/ /rma bya rmog gyen dbu rmog btsan/ /bal rmel rmugs 'dzin rar btags ma'o/ /sman pas sman gyi gtam smra smros/ /sme ba smon lam lus kyi smad/ /smig rgyu 'bras smin smag rum 'thibs/ /ming smos sman ljongs smad ras smod/ /sma bab smre sngags smos ci dgos/ /ngur smig rnam smin smon 'grin che/ /smug po smin drug sme sha can/ /smyo gtam smyung gnas bza' bu smad/ /sma ra smin ma sar btags ma'o/ /tsan dan de tsam de tsug lags/ /tsab tsub mi bya tsog tsog pu/ /tsa na ka dang tsa ko ra/ / tsug tsug sgra dang tsam pa ka /ne tso la sogs tsa rkyang ngo*/ /gtso bo gtsug tor gtsug lag khang*/ /spyi gtsug gtsub shing gnod pas gtses/ /gtsang ma gtsang bo mche ba gtsigs/ /gtsag pus gtsag sogs gas 'phul tsa'o/ /btsan po bka' btsan rdzong btsan dang*/ /btsun mo bu btsas ngan btsog btsal/ /btsun pa mig btsum btson rar btsud/ /gos btsems btsag dang btsod kyis btsos/ /'dre btsan btsan dug tshags kyis btsags/ /mtho btsams rdeg btsog sgog btsong btsugs/ /btsan thabs nor btsongs lcags kyi btsa'/ / srol btsugs chu btsir gru btsas byin/ /btso ma'i gser sogs bas 'phul tsa'o/ /rtsa ba rtse mo tshon rtsi rtsing*/ /rtswa sngon rtsi shing rtsi thog rtsub/ /rtsed mo rtsod pa rtsis rtsis mkhan/ /rtsa rgyus stobs rtsal 'bad rtsol che/ /rtsam pa rtsad gcod rtsom pa rtsoms/ /nor gyi rtsid pa 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /rtsib ma rtsig pa rar btags tsa'o/ /bka' stsol dngos grub stsal dang stsol/ /sbyin pa bgyid stsal sar btags tsa'o/ /brtson 'grus snying brtse brtse ba can/ /brtsad cing bstan bcos brtsam bya brtsams/ /so brtse rim brtsegs brtsigs shing brtsis/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i tsa'o/ /nags tshal skyed tshal tshi gu'i tshigs/ /tshogs pa sde tshan lus lang tsho/

/tshon rtsi phra tshom tshar du dngar/ /the tshom tsham rngam tshwa tsha la/ khang ba'i tshoms sogs tsha rkyang ngo*/ /ngo mtshar mtshar sdug mtshon byed mtshan/ / phyogs mtshams rgya mtsho mtshe ma skyes/ /mtshon bya mtshan gzhi mtshan nyid mtshungs/ /skyon mtshang mtshan mo tshon gyi mtshal/ /rgyal mtshan khyim mtshes ming gi mtshan/ /phyag mtshan mtshon cha mas 'phul tsha'o/ /phyag 'tshal nor 'tshol phyugs ma 'tsho/ /glo 'tshabs chu 'tshag nang du 'tshangs/ /'tshang rgya 'od 'tsher blo dang 'tsham/ /'tshag bzang gdung 'tshob skyin pa'i 'tshab/ /rlung 'tshubs longs 'tshar bar du 'tshir/ /sha 'tsho 'tshag byed dga' ba'i 'tshengs/ /brdeg 'tshog 'tshog chas ngal 'tsho ba/ /'tshe ba med sogs 'as 'phul tsha'o/ /dza lang la sogs dza rkyang ngo*/ /mdza' bo bar mdzod legs pa'i mdzes/ /dpa' mdzad mdzangs ma mdzad pa mdzod/ /mdzub mo mdzod spu shing gi mdzer/ /mdze nad mdzo rta mas 'phul dza'o/ /'dzam gling bzhin 'dzum gos 'dzad 'dzem/ /chu 'dzag 'dzir langs snod du 'dzud/ /'og 'dzul skas 'dzegs 'dzugs shing 'dzin/ / skad 'dzer 'du 'dzi chud mi 'dza'/ /nor ba'i 'dzol sogs 'as 'phul dza'o/ / kun rdzob rdzun gyi rdzab rdzub mang*/ /phyugs rdzi'i rdzongs su rdzi'u byin/ /rdzing bur rdzus skyes 'dam rdzab rdzogs/ /dzi phyogs rdza ma mkhar gyi rdzong*/ /nor rdzas rdzu 'phrul rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdzi med rdzi ma rar btags dza'o/ /gnod pas mi brdzi khro bor brdzus/ /gyen brjes zan brdzis rkang pas brdzis/ /mdos brdzangs bas 'phul rar btags dza'o/ /wa skyes pa wang chu yi wa/ /'gi'u wang pi wang skad wang wang*/ /yid la wal le wa rkyang ste/ /kwa ye khwa ta grwa ba sogs/ / wa btags can du shes par bya/ /zhwa mo zha long zhen cing chags/ /'o zho zhe dam zha rkyang ngo*/ /gzhi grub gzhi ma gzhung lugs gzhan/ /mnyam gzhag gzhal bya'i rnam gzhag byed/ /gzhon nu gzhung bzang nam gzhag dus/ /mda' gzhus bdud gzhom yid la gzhog /gzhong ba g.yang gzhi sbo gzhog gzhang*/

/gzha' tshon gzha' gsang brtag gzhig gzhug /mngag gzhug yid gzhungs khu ba gzhibs/ /gzhar yang gzhob 'thul glu gzhas byed/ /yid gzhol nang gzhug gas 'phul zha'o/ /bzhi lnga dgongs bzhed bzhad gad byed/ /bzhabs nas skra bzhar gnas su bzhag /de bzhin bzhengs bzhugs bzhon pas bzhud/ /bzhon mar 'o bzho mar bzhu bzhes/ /brlan bzha' khur bzhes bas 'phul zha'o/ /za ma za zos zwa tshod zad/ /sngags zlos zlos gar nyi zla zlum/ /zla gam zla phyed gzhan la zlo/ /zlog pa zla grogs lo zla ba/ /bskyar zlos la sogs za nyid do/ / mkhyen gzigs gcan gzan gzig gi gzugs/ /gza' skar gzi brjid rin chen gzi/ /gzan sham phrag par gzed cing gzar/ /gzong gis gzer thob gzer bu gzug /gnad gzir mda' gzas chud mi gzon/ /da gzod drin gzo zas kyi gzan/ /gru gzings gzar bu dgang blugs gzar/ /ri gzar gzungs thag gzungs sngags gzabs/ /gzengs bstod gzi mdangs gas 'phul za'o/ /bza' btung bza' bca' chang gis bzi/ /bza' mi'i na bza' bzang bor bzung*/ /bzo bos lhung bzed bzed zhal bzed/ /mi bzad las la bzur bzod pa/ /sngags bzla mi bzlog mya ngan bzla/ /gcig tu bzlums sogs bas 'phul za'o/ /yi dam yi ge cha min ya/ /ya mang ya yo yal ga yang*/ /yi rang yi dwags ya rkyang ngo*/ /g.yas g.yon g.yab mo g.yab cing g.yug /g.yang sa g.yung drung mi g.yo ba/ /g.yang len g.yang gzhi g.yog ma g.yogs/ /log g.yem g.yul sprod g.yeng bas g.yengs/ /zangs g.ya' g.yi lpags g.yar khral g.yu/ /'brong g.yag g.yer ma g.yar nas zos/ /mig g.yor g.yer kha gas 'phul ya'o/ /ra lug rwa co rdul du rlog /mngon rlom rlom sems byin rlabs che/ /byin gyis rlobs shig rba rlabs rlung*/ /rlangs pa rlon pa 'doms kyi rlig /rlabs chen rlag byed 'phul yig med/ /rtsub pa'i brlang dang brlag bya brlag /brla sha chus brlan ya ma brla/ /sra brling byin gyis brlabs par byas/ /gdon gyis brlams sogs bas 'phul rla'o/

/lwa dang la la lang ling long*/ /lam dang lam lam lag len lo/ /phal cher bshad zin khongs su gtogs/ /shar gyi shing khar shang shang shi/ /shul du shid zan shel gyi shubs/ /shugs phyung shun lpags sham thabs bcings/ /shes ldan shes pa shin tu zab/ /sha ba shub bu sha rkyang ngo*/ /bde gshegs gshis lugs de bzhin gshegs/ /gshin po'i gshags 'byed gshin rje'i gshed/ /gshen rabs gshang dkrol dbu skra gshor/ /gshis ngan g.yul gshom mo gsham bu/ /gshe smod brlan gsher bre la gshor/ /chu gsho shing gshags thong gshol rmo/ / gshog pa gshibs nas gsham du 'phur/ /spang gshongs mnyen gshin gas 'phul sha'o/ /dge bshes chos bshad sdig pa bshags/ /mdza' bshes lha bshos mchod pa bshams/ /bgo bsha' phyi bshol bre la bshar/ /gos bshus bshal drud bshan pas bshas/ /mkhar bshig chus bshal 'phrang la bshar/ / bshang gci la sogs bas 'phul sha'o/ /sangs rgyas sa ya sa phyogs ser/ / sor mo sen mo so sil snyan/ /so sor sil sil se mo do/ /tshe srog 'od srung drang srong sras/ /srol tshugs srod la srid pa srid/ /gos srab sra brtan sa srung bu/ /srin po sring mo sreg pa sram/ /srin bu sro ma srad bu sra/ /rta srab lam srang 'degs byed srang*/ /sreg byed sran ma slong mo slong*/ /slob dpon slob ma slob gnyer sla/ /rgyal srid slar yang slad ma'i dus/ /gar sla gyen slong ci yi slad/ / 'dir sleb slog pa phyi nang slog /slad slad rol sa nyid do/ /gsang sngags gsang ba gsung rab gsungs/ /gsol 'debs gsar ba gsan zhing gson/ / gser bzang 'khar gsil gseg gshang 'dzin/ kha gsag gsog gsob gsad bya gsod/ /gson po'i tshig gsol rta yi gseb/ /skad gsang gsog 'jog chud ma gsan/ kha gso gsos nas gsor gyis gsil/ /'od gsal nang gses ral ba gsigs/ /gsung dang gsum sogs gas 'phul sa'o/ / tshogs bsags skyon bsal bsam bya bsams/ /dmigs bsal drin bsabs dri ma bsangs/

/tshe bsring bsod nams bsod snyoms bsags/ /yo bsrang rgyang bsring bzod bsran che/ /dri bsung gis bsus bse ru bsad/ /bsrung bya bsrungs la bsreg bya bsregs/ /ja bsro zho bsrubs phan tshun bsres/ /ring bsrel lha bsangs ngal bsos bsdad/ /rjes bsub bsang gtor zhabs bsil bsil/ /bslad bya bslad nas bslu bya bslus/ /bslab bya bslab pa gyen du bslangs/ /yi ge bsrings sogs pas 'phul sa'o/ /ha ha hi hi hu hu zer/ /ha cang hral hrul mig hreg hrig /hwa shang rtsab hral ha nyid do/ /a ta a ma a la la/ /a ka ru dang a yu shi/ /a ru ra dang ut+pal/ /e ma a mra la sogs a'o/ /dag yig tshig gsal sgron me las yi ge'i sbyor ba rgyas par bshad pa ste gnyis pa'o/ /da ni rnam dbye tshig phrad sogs/ /bsdus te gsal bar bstan par bya/ /de la rnam dbye brgyad ces pa/ /ngo bo las dang byed pa ched/ /'byung khungs 'brel pa gnas bzhi dang*/ /bod pa'i sgra ste rim pa bzhin/ /lha klu mi dang sa rdo shing*/ /la sogs re re'i dngos ming nas/ /brjod pa rnam dbye dang po'o/ /shing la 'dzegs dang phyogs su 'gro/ /mdun du 'dug ces brjod la sogs/ /gnyis pa las su bya ba'i sgra/ /bdag gis 'di byas khyod kyis shes/ /nor gyis drin gyis bskyangs pa sogs/ /rnam dbye gsum pa byed las sgra/ /bkres la zas byin nad la sman/ /phongs la nor byin zhing la chu/ /drongs sogs bzhi ba dgos ched yin/ /mkha' las char 'bebs sa las lo/ /ri las shing dang ma las bu/ /skyes sogs lnga ba 'byung khungs tshig khyod kyi mgo dang shing gi rtse/ /gtam gyi brjod byed de yi don/ /la sogs drug pa 'brel ba'i sgra/ /gnam la nyi zla mtsho la nya/ /steng na lha bzhugs 'og tu klu/ /gnas sogs bdun pa gnas gzhi'o/ /lha dang klu sogs ming gi sngon/ /kye sbyar brgyad pa bod pa'i sgra/ /brgyad po re rer gcig tshig dang*/ /gnyis tshig mang tshig gsum gsum las/

/gong du bshad rnams gcig tshig ste/ /lha dag klu dag sogs sbyar ba/ /gnyis tshig yin no lha rnams dang*/ /klu rnams sogs sbyar mang tshig go /de yang gis gi la las sogs/ /rnam dbye dngos yin tshig grogs gzhan/ /phye ba'i ngag yin rnam dbye min/ /da ba sa kyi ga nga gi /na ma ra la bzhi bo gyi/ /mtha' rten med mtha' ci thob cing*/ /rkang ba skong phyir yi ste dper/ khyod kyi rgyab kyi ngos kyi cha/ /bdag gi gdong gi mdun gyi phyogs/ /lam gyi skor gyi gzhol gyi gzhi'i/ /de yi zhes dang da drag mthar/ /kyi thob gyur gyi brgyan gyi zer/ /'o 'u 'am gyi tsheg khyim yang*/ /rkang ba skong mi skong gis dbye/ /'i dang 'ang sogs tsheg khang min/ /mtha' rten can dang brtsegs pa dang*/ /gug kyed can la 'a mtha' med/ /ga da ba yi rjes su ni/ /cing ces ce'o ce na cig / lnga bo legs te dpe rim bzhin/ /rtag cing rtog ces dpag ce'o/ /ga ra 'dug ce na 'dir 'dug cig /bshad cing yod ces med ce'o/ /ci 'chad ce na 'di shod cig /brgyab cing thob ces chub ce'o/ /gang rgyob ce na mda' rgyob cig /nga na ma 'a ra la dang*/ /mtha' rten med mthar zhing zhes zhe'o/ /zhe na zhig ste dpe rim bzhin/ /song zhing drang zhes 'byung zhe'o/ /gang gzung zhe na 'di gzung zhig /yin zhing min zhes 'dzin zhe'o/ /zas yin zhe na don zhig gnyer/ /zhim zhing 'jam zhes 'dzum zhe'o/ /len nam zhe na nam zhig len/ / bza' zhing dga' zhes gda' zhe'o/ /du gda' zhe na 'ga' zhig snang*/ /'phyar zhing 'phur zhes 'gyur zhe'o/ /ci 'phyar zhe na dar phyor zhig /dal zhing nyal sen ngal zhe'o/ /gang tshol zhe na zas tshol zhig /za zhing bde zhes spro zhe'o/ /e 'gro zhe na ma 'gro zhig /dmigs bsal sa mthar shes dor te/ /shing zhes she'o she na shig /'dus shing nges zhes byas she'o/ /brjod ces she na da smros shig / 'das tshig na ra la gsum gyi/ /rjes su da drag thob pa'i phyir/

/'dzin cing bkal ces bstan ce'o/ /ci mkhyen ce na grol cig dang*/ /gyur cig ces pa lta bu'o/ /dri ba'am dgag pa'i tshig dag la/ /rang rang mtha' ru ma sbyar dper/ / 'dug gam byung ngam yod dam sogs/ /rdzogs mtshams rang 'drar na ro ste/ /phyug go bzang ngo bstod do sogs/ /mtha' rten med mthar 'o dang ni/ /da drag can la to ste dper/ /dge 'o 'dzin to mkhyen to dang*/ /gyur to zhes pa lta bu'o/ /na ra la sa da drag gi /rjes su te rkyang da mthar de/ /yin te sbyar te btsal te dang*/ /rgyas te gyur te don yod de/ /ga da ba ma 'a dang ni/ /mtha' rten med mthar sa ste dper/ /rtag ste 'byung ste 'grub ste gda'/ /'jom ste dga' ste bde ste bzhin/ /ga ba da drag can mthar tu/ /rtag tu rab tu gtan tu bde/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /nang du snod du rgyun du zo/ /lam du myur du mjal du 'ong*/ /sa su rten med 'a mtha' ru/ /rjes su 'di ru dga' ru gnas/ /ga da ba sa da drag kyang*/ /bdag kyang 'bad kyang thob kyang don/ /byas kyang 'on kyang bstan kyang ngo*/ /nga 'a na ma ra la yang*/ /byung yang 'ga' yang byon yang ni/ / nam yang slar yang mjal yang bzhin/ /mtha' rten med mthar 'ang 'thob cing*/ /tshig rkang skong tshe yang ste dper/ /yin du'ang zin la 'di na yang*/ /ga da na ba sa ma sa dang*/ /da drag can mthar pa dang ni/ /nga 'a ra la rten med mthar/ /ba phyed war 'bod rnams la ba/ /gzhan la pa nyid sbyar te dper/ / zag pa med pa phan pa mchog /thob pa dam pa mkhas pa ru/ /gyur pa 'ong ba la dga' ba/ /myur ba mjal ba spro ba dang*/ /lung ba mda' ba 'byor ba sogs/ / gcod mtshams ga mthar chig shad dang*/ /nga yig ma gtogs shad gong du/ /phyi tsheg mi byed tshigs bcad dang*/ /na ro can mthar nyis shad bya/ /le'u mtshams lta bur bzhi shad thob/ /dag yig tshig gsal sgron me las rnam dbye tshig phrad bshad pa ste gsum pa'o/ /da ni gong du brjod rnams la/

/'khrul sel cung zad brjod bya ste/ /dran pa nyer gzhag nye bar bzhag /rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /bsgrub bya legs par bsgrub par bya/ /bsgom bya bsgom par bya ba sogs/ /de dag rnams kyi snga ma ming*/ /phyi ma bya ba'i sgra ru 'dod/ /bya byed las ni bzhi yin te/ /byed las da lta ba dang ni/ /ma 'ongs gnyis te bya ba'i las/ /da ltar dang ni 'das pa gnyis/ /bya ba gang gi ma mtha' ru/ /byed dang 'gyur ba'i gsal byed sgra/ /dngos sam don gyis thob gyur na/ /byed las yin no de la ni/ /byed ces bya ba'i sgra yod na/ /byed las da lta ba yin la/ /'gyur zhes thob na ma 'ongs tshig /gal te ma mthar bya byas zhes/ /dngos su yod pa'am don gyis thob/ /bya ba'i las te bya zhes pa/ /thob na bya ba da ltar dang*/ /byas zin zhes pa'i sgra byung na/ /bya ba'i las ni 'das par 'dod/ / dper brjod sgom byed sgom par 'gyur/ /bsgom par bya'o bsgoms par byas/ / srung bar byed do srung bar 'gyur/ /bsrung bar bya'o bsrungs zin to/ /sgrub par byed do sgrub par 'gyur/ /bsgrub par bya'o bsgrubs zin sogs/ /byed 'gyur bya byas zin zhes pa'i/ /gsal byed sgra las shes par bya/ /de phyir bsgom bya bsgoms zin pa'i/ /tshig bsdus bsgom bsgoms sngon 'jug 'thob/ /sgom byed sgom 'gyur tshig bsdus pa'i/ /sgom sgom sa ni sngon 'jug med/ /de bzhin bsgrub par bya'o sogs/ /sngon 'jug yod dang med pa gnyis/ /bya ba'i sgra la o yig ni/ /sbyar ba byed las ma sbyar ba/ /bya ba gzhi la yod pa'i las/ /rkang ba rkyong byed brkyang bar bya/ /de bzhin klog dang bklag par bya/ /skong bskang gtong btang sgrol bsgral dang*/ /rgyob brgyab ston par byed pa dang*/ /bstan par bya sogs shes par bya/ /sgrubs shig sgoms shig byin rlobs shig /la sogs skul tshig bas 'phul med/ /bsgrub bya bsgom bya la sogs par/

/sa mtha' mi 'thob bsgrubs par byas/ /bsgoms zin sogs la sa mtha' 'thob/ /gzhan yang rnga yab ge sar dang*/ /sil snyan mngon sum gas 'phul med/ /gsha' ma gshags 'byed med na nor/ /sar ba lta bur gang yang rung*/ /skyil krung sogs la das 'phul med/ /dgung lo la sogs med na nor/ /snyan dngags la sogs gang yang rung*/ /gad mo sgra shad gas 'phul spong*/ /bser bu skyo bsangs med na nor/ /sngo bsangs lta bur gang yang rung*/ /tha gru tha ma tshar du dngar/ /tshon rtsi sogs la mas 'phul dor/ /mthe bo mtshe ma rin chen mtshal/ khyim mtshes sogs la med na nor/ /thun mongs sogs la gang yang rung*/ /tshong ba khams dang tshogs pa tshoms/ /phra ma khon 'dzin khro bo khros/ /rim gro yo byad phongs pa dang*/ /phyug po sogs la 'as 'phul med/ /mtha' 'khob tshul 'chos sogs med nor/ /phrin las phreng sogs gang yang rung*/ /yi ge nyung ngu lu gu rgyud/ /shākya sogs la ga mtha' spang*/ /phrag dog phrug gur med na nor/ kha mchu ra mda' na bza' dang*/ /rgya mtsho sogs la ma mtha' spang*/ /bya rgod rdo rjer ra mtha' med/ /mdor bsdus sogs la med na nor/ /bde gshegs sogs la gang yang rung*/ /pus mo'i lha nga sla nga dang*/ /sgo nga sogs la nga mtha' dor/ /yi dam yi rang yi dwags dang*/ /sri zhu sogs la da mtha' nor/ /se mo do la na mtha' med/ /gdu bu le rgan pa mtha' nor/ /rig sngags gsung rab mkhyen rab dang*/ /go 'phang bskyed rim rdzogs rim dang*/ /nyam chung nyam thag nyam nga ba/ /log rtog som nyi chom rkun dang*/ /nam mkha' sogs la sa mtha' nor/ / skyes rabs sogs la med na min/ /dri bzangs rgyud mangs go rims dang*/ / 'khor los sgyur sogs gang yang rung*/ /klad kod stod kor 'od kor dang*/ /a mra la sogs sa mgo med/ /ngur smrig smig rgyur med na nor/ /gzhan yang snying ka snying kha dang*/ /dkon mchog dang ni dkon cog dang*/ /ji ltar ci ltar brdzun dang rdzun/

/'od gzer 'od zer rin chen dang*/ /rin cen khyad par cher med gsung*/ /dag yig tshig gsal sgron me las 'khrul sel bshad pa ste bzhi pa'o/ /smras pa/ gzhung lugs smra ba rnams kyi mig gcig po/ /ming tshig kun gyi gzhir gyur yi ge ste/ /sbyor tshul legs shes don la mi rmongs shing*/ /gzhan du tshig 'khrul don kyang ga la zhig /thon mi'i legs bshad yi ge'i sbyor ba kun/ /ji bzhin shes pa'ang dkon na gang gi tshe/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi ma thob par/ /de srid sdeb sbyor mtha' dag su yis shes/ /'on te 'di ltar phyogs re'i brda la yang*/ /sbyangs gang blun rmongs gzhan las khyad 'phags phyir/ / mkhas pa'i stan la 'dug par 'os so zhes/ /zha lu blo ldan shes rab sogs kyis bshad/ /dam pa'i man ngag yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /mang thos lha chen ral pa'i nags klung du/ /yongs bzung blo gsal skal ldan dza h+nu'i/ /longs spyod ched du 'di na dal gyis 'bab/ /rab dkar phan 'dod yid kyis nyer drangs te/ /rab 'byams mkhas pa'i gzhung bzang du ma la/ /rab tu dpyad nas bkod pa yin mod kyi/ /rab rib nongs par gang gyur bdag gis 'chags/ / 'dir 'bad las 'ongs dge legs char gyi rgyun/ /ji snyed mchis de dge ba'i klung gzhan dang*/ /lhan cig phan bde'i mjug ngogs la zhugs te/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtshor ro gcig 'gyur phyir bsngo/ /dag yig tshig gsal sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni rnam dpyod can grags pa dpal 'byor gyis bskul bas rkyen byas/ /gzhan la'ang phan srid snyam pa'i 'dun pas/ dag yig nyer mkho/ za ma tog /'od zer brgya ba/ /don gsal sgron me/ rin cen sgron me sogs dang*/ sum rtags rtsa 'grel la'ang legs par 'dris pa sngon du btang*/ bzhed pa cung mi 'dra ba re snang yang*/ /ngag sgron gyi dgongs pa gtso bor byas te 'jug pa chung ba phal cher dor/ gzhan dag las kyang legs cha blangs te brgyan nas 'jug pa bde bar mthon po'i rigs su 'khrungs shing mdo sngags dang tha snyad kyi rig gnas du ma la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas pa ko'u shri nang so yes kyi bkas co ne'i mkhan sa dang mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa zung 'brel gyis skyong ba shākya'i dge slong rab 'byams smra ba grags pa bshad sgrub kyis dge byed kyi lor sbyar ba'o//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ dag yig tshig gsal sgron me bzhugs/ - PAGE 292 -- PAGE 291 -- PAGE 263 -
